---
title: "LMM Workshop 2026"
---

We will discuss Linear Mixed Models in the context of (visualization) user studies and beyond.

Julia is the language of choice, with the excellent MixedModels.jl package.

## Dates

10. & 11. September 2026


::: {.callout-important}
## Read this
1. Please follow the [installation instructions](installation.html) to install Julia + required packages **pre-workshop**
2. Optional: Bring your own dataset with a short description of the data variables (what ought to be modelled, by what predictors, how many levels, within / between subjects?). We are planning individual time towards the end of the workshop.
:::
